quest.title: Prince's Country
quest.description: In order to cure Madame Zuria's child, you begin a fantastical adventure. Today is the day you head to the Kingdom of the Water Imps. Just what will you encounter there?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Thelxie's Badge x10, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Is your child feeling any better?

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern, Freminet. His condition is fairly stable. The family doctor said we might be able to take him out for a stroll today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zuria! Freminet! We're here.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Hehe, seems like everyone's arrived now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not quite, aren't we missing someone? But Paimon has a guess where he might be!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Thelxieeee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Thelxie's got himself a sword and a shield now! He's lookin' sharp.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Indeed, with his weapons in hand, Thelxie looks more formidable than ever. You've really outdone yourself, Freminet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We helped, too!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Yes, you really had a good eye for materials. Everything you found was high quality.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Zuria just told me that she wants to end the adventure with a coronation ceremony. So, could I also trouble you with finding some materials for the crown?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: You can just keep an eye out for them on our way to the ruins. I was planning to collect the materials myself, but then I realized you might be able to find some prettier ones than what I could get my hands on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Consider it done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like everything's ready to go. Shall we head out?

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment. I was just thinking... Since Thelxie has already shown us his brand-new appearance, we may already be able to draw a new page in the picture book. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Paimon's excited now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What should we draw on the page?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Hmm, why don't we use the story we know as a reference? Just make the atmosphere a bit less grim...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we'll take out the sad parts and replace them with happier stuff? Sounds great to Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll give it a try. I'm not very adept at drawing, but I've seen a lot of art during my work. Now, as for the actual content of the drawing... please tell me what you'd like to see.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Let me think... We can draw the weapon. The prince has picked up the sword of courage and the shield of perseverance, which proves he has crossed the mire of doubt, and is now ready to wage war against the darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll add the weapon... Anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to give him some friends! Thelxie's got some friends by his side now, so he's no longer fighting alone.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll also draw some companions... Anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't forget to add some color.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Color. Ah, color... Yes! That's really important. The road in front of him now will no longer be just greyscale, but bursting with color and hope.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Who would've thought the page could have become so inspiring... How wonderful. Splendid ideas, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Everyone looks super pumped up, Thelxie most of all!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Are you seeing this, my son? Are you feeling inspired by this as well?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'm sure he is, Zuria, and this is still just the first page.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, Paimon can't wait to see the picture book when it's all finished! We should finish it as soon as possible, and keep up the belief and hope in our hearts!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Mhm! I'm starting to look forward to it as well, so let's get this show on the road and head towards the Kingdom of Water Imps!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures begin now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So these are the underwater ruins that Freminet found... They're pretty amazing, but still not exactly the kind that Paimon was imagining...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is the Kingdom of Water Imps, Paimon, not ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, Paimon knows, it's just... Paimon thought we'd actually see a fairytale world, like with the Water Imps' colorful houses, and the rainbow bridge...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I was hoping to put up some decorations but ran out of time to do it by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay, it's fantasy time now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Someone's already switched into fantasy mode!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: #Seems like {NICKNAME}'s already got the gist of things. You should do your best too, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, don't underestimate Paimon! Paimon can flip the switch, too. Now entering... Paimon Fantasy Mode!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem... Young adventurers! 'Tis Paimon, Guardian Goddess of this land. State your goals and intentions for visiting this nation!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: We are the companions of Prince Thelxie, Your Divine Highness. We have come to help him reclaim the glory that he has lost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Reclaiming your glory! Thy goddess here has golden glory, silver glory, and bronze glory. Which is it that the prince has lost?

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you break character, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not at all! This is the goddess's test! From your responses, the goddess has concluded that you're all brave adventurers without the taint of greed in your hearts! As such, you are worthy of everyone's respect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, please accept the goddess's reward. The goddess will now bestow all three types of glory upon you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And as for this prince... the goddess will also bestow upon you the rainbow glory, so your future will always be filled with light!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: My gratitude to Your Divine Highness for such generous blessings. Power is now surging through every part of my body.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Me... Me too... Is this the divine inspiration of legend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All thanks to the power of Goddess Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Ahem... now adventurers, forge bravely ahead and defeat the monsters that have taken over the kingdom! You will be sure to find that which you seek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, it's finally over! So, have we defeated the evil monsters and reclaimed the Kingdom of Water Imps?

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Yes, it should now be time for us to attend Thelxie's coronation ceremony... The only thing is, I didn't expect this to go so smoothly. I thought it would have taken longer for us to reach the heart of the ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: It was my mistake. I should have told Freminet earlier that we would also need a crown...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's all because {NICKNAME} and Goddess Paimon were too strong! We just eradicated all the monsters in one go.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: It's okay, Zuria. We can come back again once I've made the crown.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Then I must thank all of you again for taking the time. And you too, Thelxie, my child.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thelxie's turning out to be a real expert at fighting!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I don't think there's anything that will be able to stop him... He's like a true prince now.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Yes, I agree as well!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: #Let's head back to camp for now. I asked {NICKNAME} to search for some materials on the way because I want to make the crown as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can add an update to Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures as well! Now that we've reclaimed the Kingdom of Water Imps, it's time for us to draw some new scenes in the picture book.

talks.objective: Leave the Kingdom of Water Imps

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zuria and Freminet, why don't we draw the new pages first? Paimon really wants to update the picture book!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You just want to see someone draw Godddess Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You didn't have to say it out loud!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Haha, no problem, I'm happy to oblige. Then in that case, the story today should go something like this...

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: After overcoming many obstacles, Prince Thelxie and his brave companions finally arrived at the entrance to the Kingdom of Water Imps.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: At this time, the little fairy in the group, Paimon, revealed her true goddess form to her companions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo! The Goddess has arrived! She praised the companions for their purity, and to reward them, she bestowed upon them many blessings, and even prayed that the Prince would be able to fulfill his goal!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Bathed under the Goddess' glory, the Prince and his companions charged into the bastion of evil, chased away the monsters, and rescued the pretty Water Imps from their imprisonment. The Prince finally managed to reclaim his kingdom, but as for the crown...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, the crown isn't ready yet!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: No... The crown was within the Prince's reach, but the monsters took it with them as they fled. They haven't given up and are sure to return, but the prince is certain to reclaim the crown the next time they fight. The brilliant rainbow shall descend onto the kingdom once more...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and Paimon can almost see it all happening now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the pages are beautiful... Zuria is really talented at drawing...

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Thank you, everyone. We've also completed the second page of the picture book now. Thelxie's journey is one step closer to its end and the promised coronation...

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: My child... You'll also be able to brighten up when that time comes, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sure he will, Zuria! Who knows, perhaps the doctor will already have some good news for you when you get back home today!

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: I sure hope so, Your Divine Highness. Oh, Freminet, about the time you'll need for the crown...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Please don't worry. One day should be more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Ah, then I must thank you for your hard work. Alright, let's rendezvous here in another two days' time for our final adventure, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me.

dialogues.speaker: Zuria Destree
dialogues.text: Then see you in two days, my lovely friends. ♪♫♪~

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, it's about time we start heading off, too. You've still got some work to do, right Freminet?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'll need to go to the city shortly to get some parts for the base of the crown. I want to try out a few different designs and choose the one that looks the best.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon knew that you didn't often take commissions from others... But Paimon had no idea you'd be so dedicated once you're on the job.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Ah, well about that... It might be because...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, what's the matter? And what's with that look on your face? You're turning red... and it looks like you're about to run away and put your helmet on again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, alright, alright... We won't bother you anymore for today, Freminet. Let's see each other in two days' time!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...Okay, thank you... See you in two days.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...I hope that everyone who's found themselves in a dark place would be able to see something beautiful, and experience a miracle for themselves...

talks.objective: Go to the Kingdom of Water Imps

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The day's finally come to meet up with Zuria! Let's head over to Freminet's camp right away!
